title: Choose who can see your posts

cards.text: The FTC says privacy settings can limit who sees what you post and who can connect with you. The CISA says managing these settings can improve privacy and safety.
Check those settings from time to time. The FTC says to learn how to turn them on for your accounts, apps, and devices.
The FTC says you cannot fully control who sees your profile, even with privacy settings. Think before you share because someone may save or share a photo later.

checks.prompt: What do privacy settings help you choose?
options: Which words are in a book
checks.why: The FTC says privacy settings help limit who can see what you post.

checks.prompt: What does the FTC say to do about privacy settings?
options: Learn how to turn them on, then do it
Turn them off to save time
checks.answer: Learn how to turn them on, then do it
checks.why: The FTC says to learn how to turn privacy settings on, then use them.

checks.prompt: What is a good step before you post a photo?
options: Send it to everyone you know
checks.why: The FTC says to think before posting because people may save or share what you put online.

takeaway: Check your privacy settings and think before you share.

sources.name: FTC, Heads Up: Stop. Think. Connect.
